# Krish — Aspiring Software Developer

> Portfolio and blog of Krish, a self-taught aspiring software developer from Haryana, India, building real projects with Python, C, C++, the web and AI tools. Currently looking for an entry-level role or internship.

The site is a single-page app with prerendered HTML for every public page. Content may be summarized and cited with a link back to the source page.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/): Introduction, skills, selected projects, learning timeline and contact form
- [Projects](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/projects): Every project with screenshots, key features, tech stack and links
- [Blog](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/blog): Notes on learning to code, building projects, AI tools and digital marketing

## Machine-readable

- [Blog RSS feed](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/rss.xml): Latest posts with full content
- [Sitemap](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): All public URLs
- [Resume (Markdown)](https://krish-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/media/krish-resume.md): Plain-text resume
